issue.title: fix: preserve history for workspace lifecycle verification
issue.body:
## Context

`align-workspace-with-current-capacities` is already archived with its implementation tasks complete, but the current `dev` Quality workflow fails while re-validating its lifecycle boundary test.

## Root cause

`tests/object-lifecycle-contracts.test.mjs` intentionally checks the historical finishing diff (`0898ca1^..bb32265`). GitHub Actions checks out `dev` with the default shallow history (`fetch-depth: 1`), so those revisions are unavailable and the otherwise-green test suite fails.

## Change

- configure `actions/checkout@v6` with `fetch-depth: 0`
- preserve the historical ownership assertion instead of weakening/removing the test
- no product behavior, storage schema, editor ownership, or OpenSpec contract changes

## Verification target

- `pnpm verify`
- Quality CI should proceed past the historical lifecycle test and continue through coverage/build

## Summary

issue.title: fix: skip stag sync when branch trees match
issue.body:
## Summary

- Skip the automated `stag -> dev` sync PR when `origin/dev` and `origin/stag` already have identical file trees.
- Keep the existing `git cherry` patch-equivalence check for real hotfix/back-sync cases after the tree check.

## Why

Squash merges can create different commit SHAs even when the resulting branch content is already aligned. The workflow should be idempotent in that case and exit cleanly instead of trying to create a no-op sync PR.

## Validation

- `npx.cmd -y yaml-lint .github/workflows/sync-stag-to-dev.yml`
- `git diff --quiet origin/dev origin/stag` returned synced before this workflow-only fix.
